description: This file declares the interface and classes for a GStreamer source component within the Rialto media server. It includes class definitions for GstSrc and its factory, along with associated methods and properties related to GStreamer pipeline integration, such as setup and initialization of source elements, and management of appsrc instances.

classes.name: GstSrcFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing instances of IGstSrc within the Rialto server, implementing singleton pattern with thread safety.

classes.name: GstSrc
classes.description: Implementation of the IGstSrc interface, managing GStreamer source element setup, configuration, and integration with the media pipeline.

methods.name: GstSrcFactory::getGstSrc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton IGstSrc instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: GstSrc::setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Configures and adds an appsrc element to the GStreamer pipeline with specified stream info and callbacks.

methods.name: GstSrc::allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Finalizes setup after all appsrc elements have been added to the pipeline.

methods.name: GstSrc::createPayloader
methods.description: Creates and returns a GStreamer payloader element.
